classification.difficultyReason: Express two lengths using the shared unknown height, equate their difference to 8, and factor and solve; the parts explicitly supply this sequence.

content.prompt: Find $x$. Round your answer to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Two right triangles share vertical height x; near angle 60 degrees and far angle 30 degrees; the difference of the horizontal lengths is 8.
spec.mathematics: Use tangent as opposite over adjacent, rearrange horizontal length as height divided by tangent, and subtract the shorter horizontal side from the full side.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and unknown labels appear; answers remain in the solution fields.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Express the shorter and full horizontal lengths in terms of $x$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use the difference of 8 to form an equation in $x$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Factor out $x$, then solve the equation.
